content_sections.heading: About TMC
content_sections.text: Tata Memorial Centre is described in the notice as a grant-in-aid institute under the Department of Atomic Energy, Govt. of India. The post is at Tata Memorial Hospital, Parel, Mumbai. The notice is signed by Prof. S. S. Laskar, Director (Academics), TMC, and is dated 09.11.2026.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice does not print a category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Applications are invited from Indian Nationals. The notice does not mention experience. Candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility details. The age limit is 40 years. It is relaxable by 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC and 10 years for physically handicapped candidates. The notice does not print an "as on" date for age.

rows.qualification: MD/DNB in (Respiratory Medicine), (Pulmonary Medicine) OR DM (Pulmonary Medicine)

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The tenure of the Senior Resident post is up to 31.07.2027. The notice does not mention allowances, extension or travel allowance.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for TMC SENIOR RESIDENT
content_sections.text: There is no separate application form in the notice. Eligible and interested candidates may attend the interview on 23.11.2026 with the documents listed below. Carry the documents named in the notice. Candidates who wish to attend through hybrid mode must send their CV/Resume along with all certificates to [email protected] on or before 20.11.2026 by 04:00 p.m. Queries may be mailed to [email protected] .

faq.question: Q1. How many Senior Resident vacancies are there in TMC?
faq.answer: There is 1 post of Senior Resident, in the Department of Pulmonary Medicine at Tata Memorial Hospital, Mumbai.

faq.question: Q2. When is the TMC Senior Resident walk-in interview?
faq.answer: It is on 23.11.2026 at 09:00 A.M. Reporting is from 08:30 A.M. to 09:00 A.M. at Staff Clinic, 3rd Floor, Service Block, Tata Memorial Hospital, Parel, Mumbai.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for TMC Senior Resident?
faq.answer: MD/DNB in (Respiratory Medicine), (Pulmonary Medicine) OR DM (Pulmonary Medicine).

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the TMC Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: The age limit is 40 years, relaxable by 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC and 10 years for physically handicapped candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a TMC Senior Resident?
faq.answer: Consolidated remuneration is Rs. 1,33,623/- p.m. (Gross Pay) for MD/DNB and Rs. 1,45,530/- p.m. (Gross Pay) for DM.

faq.question: Q6. How can I attend the TMC interview in hybrid mode?
faq.answer: Send your CV/Resume with all certificates to [email protected] on or before 20.11.2026 by 04:00 p.m.

faq.question: Q7. How long is the Senior Resident tenure at TMC?
faq.answer: The notice states the tenure is up to 31.07.2027, on consolidated remuneration.

faq.question: Q8. Who can apply for this TMC post?
faq.answer: Indian Nationals with the qualification above who are eligible and interested may attend the interview.

faq.question: Q9. What should I carry to the TMC interview?
faq.answer: Carry your Resume, Photo ID Proof, and original and attested copies of all qualification and experience certificates.
